## Golem Guard (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
Itac barbarian 13  
CN Medium humanoid (human)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** Perception +20  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+1 dodge, +2 Dex, +9 natural, –2 rage)  
**hp** 234 (13d12+78)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +8, **Will** +8  
**Defensive Abilities** improved uncanny dodge, trap sense +4; **DR** 4/—  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** +2 golem armor +21/+16/+11 (1d8+9/21–20), +2 golem armor +21 (1d8+9/21–20)  
**Special Attacks** greater rage (30 rounds/day), rage powers (animal fury, guarded stance (+3 dodge vs. melee), increased damage reduction +1, powerful blow +4, strength surge +13, terrifying howl [DC 23])  

 Base Statistics  

 When not raging, the golem guard’s statistics are:  

 **AC** 21, touch 12, flat-footed 19; **hp** 129; **Fort** +10, **Will** +5; +2 golem armor +21/+16/+11 (1d8+9/21–20), +2 golem armor +21 (1d8+9/21–20); **Str** 18, **Con** 14; **CMB** +17, CMD 29; Skills Climb +15, Swim +13.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 24, **Dex** 15, **Con** 20, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +20; **CMD** 31  
**Feats** Alertness, [Throw Anything](../../rules/feats/throw-anything.md), Double Slice, Lightning Reflexes, Two-Weapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Rend, Weapon Focus (golem armor), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Catch Off-Guard is part of Throw Anything; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +8, Climb +18, Handle Animal +6, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (nature) +7, Perception +20, Ride +9, Sense Motive +3, Survival +12, Swim +16  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** fast movement  
**Gear** golem armor
